goal.objective: Explain in 15 seconds that the demo service connects online classes to exams.
goal.desiredAction: Visit the demo address shown on the end card
goal.successSignal: A silent viewer can retell: class, then exam, then the name

prohibitions: rows of identical icon cards instead of story

treatment.point_of_view: The line that ends one scene is always the visual cause of the next.
treatment.dramatic_device: One unfinished ink ring that gets a new job in each scene
treatment.visual_language: Soft blue and white on textured paper, three clearly different looks
treatment.camera_language: Virtual camera only to reveal a relation between elements; no zoom without cause
treatment.typography: Short DOM text, Persian shaped, numbers isolated LTR, headline never competes with motion
treatment.sonic_arc: One theme that evolves; SFX only on actions; musical ending
director_prohibitions: decorative transitions unrelated to the action

scenes.dramatic_function: capture attention with an action, not an immediate logo
scenes.visual: A blue ink line draws an unfinished ring; the question text appears inside it.
scenes.motion_intent: One drawn action with a clear start and a held stop
scenes.transition_logic: The end of the ring line reaches the next frame's edge and becomes its border
scenes.audio_intent: Pen texture, then the first notes of the motif
director_acceptance: A silent viewer follows one main movement before reading
Hero text height >= 12% of frame height in 9x16
No empty zone > 30% of frame height without motion

scenes.dramatic_function: show one understandable interaction instead of an icon
scenes.visual: The ring turns into a class window; one raised-hand marker lights up and the window reacts; the frame then flips into an exam sheet.
scenes.motion_intent: Layers open in limited depth; focus on one interaction
scenes.transition_logic: The flip of the class window is the exam sheet's entrance
scenes.audio_intent: Soft click on the marker; motif continues
director_acceptance: A silent viewer can retell: class then exam

scenes.dramatic_function: resolve the question with the identity and the action
scenes.visual: The ring closes into the emblem; a cream card slides in with the address in an LTR pill.
scenes.motion_intent: Build then settle; last beat is the CTA press
scenes.audio_intent: Musical ending on the CTA press
director_acceptance: Address is readable on a phone-size still
Logo is the verified file or passes the overlay check
